title: Implement optional OpenAPI contract declaration validation
summary: Commit 4029a25 adds parse_contracts to scanner/src/dogwatch/contracts.py and adds the new scanner/tests/test_contracts.py (28 tests). The checks run in this order: id presence, type, is_kebab_id, uniqueness; then path presence, type, textual syntax, textual uniqueness. Each failure raises one config-invalid error with the IC-ERR-4 template text. Commit bc2eaf8 is the operator-authorized option (A) change to scanner/tests/test_validate.py, and it is the only file outside the allowed list. It removes "contracts" from the parametrize; that left the parametrize empty, so the empty guard test is deleted. Its `import sys` had no other use, so it is dropped too, because ruff F401 would otherwise fail.
